map.输入紫外线指数（UV Index，0–16），查询风险等级、防护建议与不同肤色的: Enter the UV Index (0-16) to look up the risk level, protection advice and burn times for different skin tones
map.对防雷/防风/防洪设施做合规点检算达成率。: Run compliance spot checks on lightning protection, wind and flood facilities to get an achievement rate.
map.按达成率评防护等级。: Rate the protection level by achievement rate.
map.：应防护点 25、达标 22 → 达成率=22/25×100=88%，评级「基本: 25 protection points and 22 achieved -> achievement rate = 22/25 x 100 = 88%, rated "basically compliant" (75-89%), with 3 points to rectify by a deadline.
map.：达成率≥90 合格、75–89 基本合格、60–74 需整改、<60 不合格，: >=90 compliant, 75-89 basically compliant, 60-74 needs rectification, <60 non-compliant, on the same framework as lightning protection compliance.
map.防护评估多久一次？: How Often Should Protection Be Assessed?
map.汛前/雷季前必检，台风多发的季度加密，灾后复检。: Must be checked before the flood season and before the thunderstorm season, more often in quarters with frequent typhoons, and rechecked after a disaster.
map.基本合格能运营吗？: Is Basic Compliance Enough to Operate?
map.可但须限期整改未达标点，重大风险点不合格应停用。: Acceptable but the non-conforming points must be rectified by a deadline; a major risk point that fails means the item must be taken out of service.
